run_card.verdict_rationale: Catalogue-internal holdout cannot see far-field truth by design (truth = catalogue; far-field excluded), so holdout DTI = 0.0 (negative on the proxy). Not promotable to a scored weekly slot on proxy evidence. Supported instead by GEMSDOE32's generative truth model (+0.0247, 12/12 draws positive for scatter-smoothed off-catalogue emission). Shipped as a live measurement probe, not a scored slot.

hypothesis.title: Scatter-smoothed off-catalogue far-field emission
layers: OOF/full-label fault probabilities from the cached 32-band label-free feature stack (HistGradientBoosting)
scatter smoothing: gaussian sigma = 1.85 px (inferred truth scatter scale)
catalogue-distance far-field mask: d(catalogue) >= 3 px = 300 m, catalogue pixels excluded
anti-overlap buffer: dots excluded within 3 px of every GEMSDOE27 registry raster's dots (LANE rule)
hypothesis.mechanism: Blur the detector surface by the ~1.85 px scale at which hidden truth is scattered around mapped traces, then emit only off-catalogue far-field picks dot-thinned at d=1.5 px. This targets truth pixels the catalogue misses (scattered around, not on, mapped traces) and avoids the false-positive mass of emitting on/near catalogue. Written all-finite (zeros outside, no nodata, exact 0.0/1.0 in [0,1]) to satisfy the portal [0,1] validator.
hypothesis.named_non_fault_mimic: Lithologic contacts, geophysical survey seams, and remanent-magnetization lineaments (magnetic/gravity edges without faults); alluvial-fan edges, playas, shorelines and road cuts (topographic lineaments without faults) can produce the same edge/scarp signature.
hypothesis.why_catches_missing_fault: A permeable fault can localize fluid flow and deformation without a catalogued Quaternary surface trace; off-catalogue emission targets exactly those structures. The catalogue holdout over-rewards near-catalogue pixels and is blind to far-field truth, so proxy DTI understates real potential.
hypothesis.differs_from_repo: GEMSDOE27 slots emit ON the catalogue base (dotted H19-5) plus topology gap dots near it; GEMSDOE32's h33 emits far-from-catalogue dots from a plain thinned base without scatter smoothing and without topology links. This combines scatter smoothing + off-catalogue exclusion + topology-deconflicted unique dots.
